items.title: Lorraine Feather interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 22, 2023
items.q: There’s the song about the mouse, the Annie Ross song... I saw him perform — I saw him with Yolande Bavan who came after Annie Ross as you know.

ctx.x: Do you recall if your mother or if your father explained — tried to explain to you what Jon Hendricks and others were doing when they took those melodies that people had improvised and wrote lyrics. Did you understand that at that point?

No. I was never told what they did. It just was. It was just something that my mom and I used to try and sing along to with not very much success like Jackie. There’s the song about the mouse, the Annie Ross song, and everything. It was just so much fun. And I remember meeting Jon many times. He was a Virgo like me, he always used to bring that up. And I saw him perform — I saw him with Yolande Bavan who came after Annie Ross as you know. And it was just — it was just part of my musical life. It was some of the…
I love that vision. Like you know your classmates might have been singing [sings] Lollipop, Lollipop oh Lolli Lollipop, and you’re singing Lambert, Hendricks & Ross. © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-
